description: Get the root outcome group for an account or course context, the entry point into the outcome tree. Returns the top-level outcome group (id, title, subgroups_url, outcomes_url); walk from there with list_outcome_group_subgroups for its child groups and list_outcome_group_outcomes for outcomes linked directly under a group, or use list_outcome_groups for a flat listing of every group in the context instead of walking the tree.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

context_type.description: Whether to read outcomes from an account or course context.

name: get_root_outcome_group
title: Get Root Outcome Group
